object.attr: derived: written with the security fix, from the requirement and the code view's finding.
object.description: With a merge stopped on a conflicting object file, resolve it while the merge's result also holds, in turn, a path with backslash parent parts, one with slash parent parts, a git hook path, a non-format file in a document folder, an object file whose name isn't an object ID, a file one folder too deep and a drive path; then a links file whose folder is a link to a folder elsewhere; then nothing extra. Expected: each resolution with an extra path is refused before any file is written, and nothing appears outside the document folders or in the hooks folder; the one through the link is refused and writes nothing elsewhere; the plain resolution writes the object file and the manifest.
